title: Community & governance
description: How this game is led, who builds it, what help it wants, and where it's going. Encodes the fork-and-lead model: every project declares its decision structure so contributors know the rules before they invest. File: community.yaml.

model.description: lead = one designer decides (auteur + periphery); council = named maintainers decide together (Wesnoth model); open = maintainers merge anything passing playtest bar. Forking is always the appeal process.

maintainers.description: Who can accept suggestions into main.

decision_process.description: Plain words: how do changes get in? What evidence moves a banlist?

contribution_guide.description: Relative path or URL to contributing docs.

contributors.description: Everyone who shaped the game — including people who never touch git. Playtesters in playtests/*.json are auto-credited by fmt credits; list here for roles beyond that.

open_calls.description: Help wanted — surfaced as badges on the game page.

roadmap.description: Where the game is going — communities rally around visible direction.

target.description: Rough timeframe ('2026-Q4') — promises are commits, this is direction.
